PRIYALA TALE
Technical Project Manager | AI Initiatives & Digital Transformation
Mumbai, 400013 | +91 7977378854 | priyalatale10@gmail.com
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Technical Project Manager with four years at HDFC Life identifying, prioritising, and delivering AI and digital transformation 
initiatives end to end — from use case and business case through delivery, rollout, user enablement, and change management. 
Built and scaled an enterprise Generative AI product single-handedly, delivered an AI/OCR solution into production, and created 
an enterprise AI showcase for Executive Committee and business audiences. Works across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid 
environments within the governance, security, privacy, and Responsible AI controls of a regulated insurer.
CORE COMPETENCIES
AI Use-Case Identification, Evaluation & Prioritisation  •  End-to-End AI Delivery  •  Generative AI Tools (Google Gemini, ChatGPT, 
Microsoft Copilot, Claude)  •  Stakeholder Management & Communication  •  Vendor Management  •  Scope, Timeline, Risk, 
Dependency & Budget Management  •  Project Governance  •  Business & Technology Collaboration  •  Change Management, 
Training & User Enablement  •  Adoption Metrics, Business Outcomes & ROI Tracking  •  Responsible AI, Security & Privacy 
Compliance  •  Scaling AI Solutions & Enterprise Productivity  •  Agile / Waterfall / Hybrid Delivery  •  JIRA, Confluence  •  AWS & 
GCP  •  RPA & Intelligent Automation  •  OCR / Document AI
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Project Manager
HDFC Life — Mumbai, Maharashtra  |  July 2022 – Present
AI-Assisted Production Support: LogBridge
	• Currently architecting LogBridge, commissioned on the back of QueryBridge’s adoption: EventBridge listens for CloudWatch 
error logs and triggers a Lambda API that queries them, applies AI to interpret the failure, and pushes an alert with a 
suggested fix to L0/L1 support on Teams.

	• Designed to remove manual triage from production support — first-line teams get context and a fix at the point of alert 
instead of raising a ticket.


AI Adoption, Enablement & Change Management
	• Conceived and ran AI Day, an enterprise-wide showcase of the organisation's AI initiatives to Executive Committee members 
and business users.

	• Curated the line-up across functions — document AI/OCR, video masking, SQL translation, pitch generation, resume scoring 
— so each audience saw AI applied in their own domain.

	• Brought in AWS and Google as partners, using the forum to surface live use cases to sponsors and build stakeholder buy-in 
for adoption.


Building & Scaling an AI Product End to End: QueryBridge
	• Moved from managing AI delivery to originating it — identified the use case, built the business case, developed a Gemini-
powered SQL translation platform, deployed it, and own the enhancement pipeline.

	• Drove adoption through demos, onboarding, training material, and a feedback-to-release loop, tracking usage to prioritise 
enhancements. 100+ SQL workflows translated to date, with per-workflow turnaround down by ~90%.


Applied AI Delivery — Gemini Vision OCR
	• Delivered a Gemini Vision OCR solution for payee verification in policy servicing — 80–85% extraction accuracy, ~60% 
reduction in manual verification effort.

	• Ensured compliance with organisational governance, security, privacy, and Responsible AI guidelines — accuracy thresholds, 
human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and exception handling, signed off by risk and IT security.

	• Identified, evaluated, and prioritised AI use cases against business objectives — scoring on value, data readiness, and 
feasibility — and converted the shortlist into a funded roadmap.


Platform & Data Migration Ownership
	• Owned an AWS-to-GCP data migration across 70+ tables — script translation, architectural redesign, STTM validation, UAT, 
and production repointing — enabling fresher T-day data for analytics and AI workloads.

	• Coordinated business sign-off, cutover planning, and rollback readiness across dependent teams, keeping a live customer-
facing service stable.



Modernising Legacy Solutions
	• Re-architected legacy solutions that were being scaled vertically to keep pace with growing volumes, moving them to 
serverless, cloud-native services on a consumption-based model that scales with demand rather than provisioned capacity.

	• Re-designed a legacy customer-facing service into a cloud-native omnichannel solution on AWS, cutting infrastructure cost 
and removing the throughput ceiling.

	• Centralised 5+ recurring functionalities into reusable templates and modules to shorten subsequent delivery cycles.


Delivery Leadership Foundation — 50+ Automation & Digital Projects
	• Led end-to-end delivery of 50+ automation and digital projects across 5+ insurance functions — RPA, Excel automation, web 
applications, microservices — managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, dependencies, and governance.

	• Managed two cross-functional teams (12–15 members) across business, technology, and vendor partners; translated 100+ 
requirements into delivery tasks, mitigated 25+ risks, and held 95%+ milestone adherence using JIRA and Confluence.

	• Ran Agile ceremonies alongside Waterfall-governed programs, adapting the delivery model to project and audit needs.


FLAGSHIP PROJECTS
QueryBridge — Generative AI SQL Translation Platform
	• Problem: SQL migration from Oracle and legacy sources to BigQuery was manual, slow, and error-prone, holding up the cloud 
migration.

	• Solution: Flask web application using Google Gemini to translate and validate SQL into BigQuery-compliant syntax, built for 
non-specialist users.

	• Ownership: Idea, business case, prototype, development, UAT, deployment, rollout, internal marketing, training, and change 
management — delivered individually.

	• Outcome: 100+ SQL workflows translated to date, with per-workflow turnaround reduced by ~90%, accelerating migration 
timelines; established a reusable GenAI pattern now applied to other engineering workflows.

	• Recognition: HDFC Life Innovation Catalyst Award, signed off by the CTO, Chief Data Officer, and Head of Business Solution 
Group.


Policy Document Delivery Platform — Cloud-Native Customer-Facing Solution
	• Problem: A legacy service for sharing policy document soft copies was slow, costly to run, and single-channel.

	• Solution: Re-designed as a cloud-native omnichannel platform on AWS, with a policy document sharing API on Lambda, API 
Gateway, S3, and SES.

	• Outcome: 26% reduction in customer turnaround time, 87% reduction in operational cost, and manual handling removed 
from the delivery journey.

	• Recognition: Best Use of Technology — Dine with ALPHASEC, October 2024.


EDUCATION
Master of Computer Applications
Jain University, Bangalore  |  Graduating September 2026
Bachelor of Science, Information Technology
Jai Hind College, Mumbai  |  May 2022
CERTIFICATIONS
	• Project Management 101: PMP Certification Training — March 2024

	• GCP — Google Cloud Platform Concepts — November 2025

	• AWS for Beginners, HDFC Life — March 2024


AWARDS
	• Innovation Catalyst Award — HDFC Life, JFM’26 (CTO, Chief Data Officer, and Head of Business Solution Group; Project 
INSPIRE)

	• Best Use of Technology — Dine with ALPHASEC, October 2024

	• Performer of the Quarter (JAS) — HDFC Life, October 2022

	• Employee of the Month — HDFC Life, March 2022


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Languages: English, Hindi, Marathi
